host_mode: C89 with pedantic-errors, Wall/Wextra/Werror, AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer
leak_sanitizer: Disabled only for executor ptrace incompatibility; no candidate or harness heap allocation. Address/UB checks remain enabled.
native_width_checks: Temporary IDO C89 compile assertions pass for sizeof(unsigned long)==sizeof(void*)==4, ResourceGroup32, SampleRecord28 and RegisteredSamples12. Host address-control assertion checks unsigned-long and pointer widths equal; valid bounded allocated addresses are used.
limits: Valid aligned allocated resources, bounded offsets, sentinel-terminated sample/group lists, configured nonnegative stack/registry counts and callback effects within capacity are required. Pointer-containing layouts are native-width evidence, not host sizeof. Source semantics and synthetic callbacks do not establish strict matching, concurrency safety, malformed-input safety, original helper algorithms, whole-game or cartridge coverage.
